What should SwitchFlow improve?

Give the agents enough context to design a useful, controlled workflow.

Customer mode listens for an order such as “I want 10 cookies” in the connected chat group. Agents check capacity, you decide in Approvals, and SwitchFlow replies in that customer’s thread.

HELP

How customer requests reach your business

  1. Customer mentions your intake agent in the connected group and describes the request.
  2. Intake agent acknowledges receipt and assigns a request reference.
  3. Specialist agents check your selected capacity file and explain missing information.
  4. You review the evidence in Approvals and accept or decline.
  5. SwitchFlow reserves capacity after acceptance and posts the decision in the original customer thread.
  6. Shared record keeps the request, analysis, decision, and reply together for review.

Add a CSV with item,capacity,committed in Data & schedules before creating a capacity-based workflow.
